name: Webform Simplify
description: Hides parts of the Webform interface.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction 
 Webform Simplify allows certain parts of the Webform user interface to be hidden. This helps to de-clutter forms and present a more user-friendly experience to content editors.

 Back to top 

 What can be hidden? 
 
 Help : hide Webform-provided help sections with video and text instructions 
 Element forms : hide certain fields or tabs from element forms through config 
 Webform settings : hide certain parts of webform settings through permissions
